title: pvPartitionBalancer
body:
## pvPartitionBalancer

For partitioned data (vtkPartitionedDataSet or collections), makes every MPI process hold the same number of partitions by adding empty (null) partitions, and drops empty input partitions. Squash (ParaView default) pads only up to the largest per-process count; Expand gives every non-empty partition its own global index, so partition n exists on exactly one process. Data and geometry are unchanged. Use it before writers or filters that expect a consistent partition layout; in a serial run it only removes empty partitions.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PartitionBalancer`. Identity: `filters/PartitionBalancer`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
